rules: Never persist a visual cell ID as semantic terrain authority.
Only reviewed cells may be selected by production rendering.
Generated atlases are derived output and are not edited directly.
Pinned or third-party source edits create Havenwild-owned overrides.
Cave entrances and waterfalls are composited features over a valid structural host face.
Raw geological byte height is quantized into structural tiers before cliff collision or face selection.
A procedural edge may block movement only when the active provider can render a complete reviewed assembly for that edge.
The packaged OGA sheet is a read-only connected-art reference until Pixel Studio publishes a normalized atlas.
No procedural collision or runtime face may be certified from an misclassified or unreviewed source region.
Runtime cliffs fail open while the normalized structural role family is incomplete.
authoritative_pipeline: heightfield -> contours -> structural cliff recipe -> asset lookup -> draw

renderer_policy.input: resolved structural cliff recipe plus resolved visual resource

validator_policy: verify resolved recipes/resources; never repair topology or choose replacement artwork
